findings.reason: Verified in packages/lib/server/queries/teams/index.ts: isTeamAdmin already matches ADMIN or OWNER, and isTeamOwner matches only OWNER, so the && in the handler lets only owners through and refuses team admins who are neither organizer nor attendee.

The diff confirms sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) gets the raw input, so an already-present attendee in the input is treated as new and gets the 'new event scheduled' email; real but minor and limited to that edge case.

The server schema has no uniqueness check, and the blacklist is lowercased while the incoming guest is not, so an input like 'Spam@blocked.com' bypasses a 'spam@blocked.com' blacklist entry; duplicates in one request also create duplicate attendee rows via createMany.

Any attendee-matched user can send unbounded emails through the app mailer to arbitrary addresses since guests has no max, a plausible abuse path, but it is phrased as a 'consider' suggestion and partly a product-permission decision.

Verified that isInvalidEmail is reset only in the Cancel handler, not in onSuccess or on dialog close via onOpenChange, so the stale 'Emails must be unique and valid' error persists after a successful add and reappears on reopen.

Verified that message is a non-empty template string so the 'message || t(...)' fallback never runs, and that a missing err.data yields 'undefined: ...' in the toast; a real cosmetic defect in an error path.
